item.title: Greater Toronto Area Transit (GTAT) — Project Overview
item.dc:creator: DevTimmOfTO
item.description: A large-scale, high-fidelity recreation of the TTC and Greater Toronto Area transit networks in Lotus Simulator. Currently in early development (Foundation Stage), focusing on routes 509 (Harbourfront) and 510 (Spadina) with authentic TTC broad-gauge track geometry, custom-modelled stations, and a Flexity Outlook vehicle in progress. Long-term roadmap covers the full TTC streetcar and subway network plus regional partners (MiWay, Brampton Transit, GO Transit, UP Express). Seeking contributors: 3D modelling (Blender), scripting, sound design, and textures.
